llm_response.reason: The website uses the well-known 'One Teaspoon' brand and images but the domain is unrelated and does not match the official store. There is a lack of legitimate e-commerce signals (no contact or about info, only a cart link, no official social links), which are strong indicators of a scam shop. The site uses tactics common to scam websites: spoofing a legitimate brand (#16), ambiguous customer service (#6/#7), and urgency/secure shopping claims (#3/#13). The product assortment mimics real products to deceive visitors (#5).
